_comment: The target files the sample ships, and the locales it ships them in.
A file earns a place here when the historic translations cover enough of it
that it can be shipped in the target language alone. Both entries are
key-addressed catalogues, so a partly translated one is written with only
the keys that have an answer: the file carries no English standing in for
German, and the keys that are missing are honestly missing.
Prose cannot be shipped that way — half a translated page is not a page —
so the documentation, the contracts and the campaign material stay
untranslated until someone translates them, which is the work the sample is
supposed to have in front of it.
